title: Engineering hybrid nanotube wires for high-power biofuel cells
subject: Physics
question: What is the percentage of retained current density (I/I₀) for the Carbon Nanotube (CNT) fibre electrode (solid circles) at the 7-hour mark, according to the chart and its caption?

gold_answer.long_answer: The chart shows the relative electrode stability over time. The solid circles represent the Carbon Nanotube (CNT) fibre electrode. At the 7-hour mark on the horizontal axis, the corresponding solid circle is located at approximately 82% on the vertical axis (I/I₀). This value is explicitly confirmed in the original caption.

original_caption: Scatter plot depicting the temporal dependence of relative electrode stability ($I/I_0$, %) over a 7-hour period for two electrode types. The vertical axis represents the percentage of retained current density (scale 0–120%), and the horizontal axis represents time in hours (0–8 h). Solid circles correspond to the Carbon Nanotube (CNT) fibre electrode, which demonstrates high stability with a slow, linear decay rate, retaining approximately 82% of its initial current by hour 7.
